abortion.text: Calderon authored AB 254, extending California's medical-privacy protections to reproductive and sexual health data collected by health apps and digital services.
abortion.quote: make a business that offers a reproductive or sexual health digital service to a consumer for the purpose of allowing the individual to manage the individual's information

tax.text: On her campaign site she calls for free-market principles, lower taxes, and reduced regulation.
tax.quote: I stand for free-market principles, lower taxes, and reduced regulation.

schools.text: She says she wants to empower parents and backs charter schools, vouchers, and homeschooling.
schools.quote: I support charter schools, vouchers, and homeschooling options.

safety.text: She campaigns on law and order and supporting law enforcement.
safety.quote: I'm committed to law and order, supporting our law enforcement and securing our borders.

immigration.text: She lists securing the borders among her public safety priorities.
immigration.quote: I'm committed to law and order, supporting our law enforcement and securing our borders.

guns.text: She says she will stand up for the right to self-defense.
guns.quote: Your right to self-defense is essential, and I'll stand up for it.

abortion.text: She states that she is pro-life and that every life must be protected.
abortion.quote: I am pro-life and believe every life has purpose, is precious, and must be protected.
